grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, bicarb, oil, vinegar, seeds and fresh broccoli and thyme are all ordinary cupboard and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is a standard Tesco line at an everyday price, and purple sprouting broccoli is stocked in winter.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a knife and a baking tray, and soda bread is a beginner-friendly technique.

works.reason: 450g flour to 325ml water with vinegar and bicarb makes a workable soft soda dough, and 25 minutes at 220°C will bake a round cut into 8 wedges through, giving enough for four as a snack.

honest_times.reason: Chopping 200g broccoli and mixing a soda dough fits in 15 minutes, and the 25-minute bake matches the step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including thyme and pumpkin seeds, is used, nothing unlisted appears, and 'sprouting broccoli' matches its id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm savoury scones suit a cold January afternoon, and the broccoli, stalks and all, is the main flavour and named in the title.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Half wholemeal flour with a good amount of broccoli and seeds makes a filling, real-food snack a family would bake again.
